Ball bearing mounted, reliable 2-blade mower deck.

records.Name: Protective gloves Functional Light Comfort 10
records.Description:
These protective gloves are designed for professional use in forestry and landscaping work all year round. Upper and water-resistant goat skin palm
The inner layer of the highly elastic insert absorbs shock and protects your hands inside. Stain resistant rubber wrist Reflective logos for added visibility.
The second joint of the index finger is touchscreen compatible, so you can operate your smartphone or other devices while wearing gloves.

records.Description: Lightweight, flexible padded headband with pressure adjustment. Can be used with or without a hard hat. Hearing protection rating 25dB(A) NRR.

records.Name: Wine demijohn 15L in a plastic basket
records.Description: A narrow-opening glass demijohn with capacity of 15 L. Intended for fermenting wine, beer, and mead, and for infusion liquors. The removable plastic casing enables washing the carboy thoroughly, while at the same time protecting the glass against shattering. The glass of which the carboys are made is sodium glass that features all the approvals for contact with food products. The advantage of glass carboys is their high tightness and possibility of “peeking” at the fermentation process.

records.Name: Glass bottle 250 ml with cap
records.Description: These reusable 16 fl oz glass bottles are fantastic for home fermentation. Made of durable, high-quality glass, these bottles will last you a lifetime if well taken care of. Whether you’re making your own kombucha, kefir, ginger beer, hard seltzer, soda or beer, these bottles can handle the pressure! Pressure rated up to 100 psi, these bottles will prevent the dreaded “bottle bombs” from going off in your kitchen.

records.Name: Jar with tap 4 L
records.Description: A glass jar with a tap, perfect for serving water, lemonade, juice, iced tea, flavored water, but also punch. Thanks to the tap, you can easily serve your favorite drinks in an effective way. We will use the jar both in the garden and during family gatherings. Thanks to the closed lid, no insects can get into our drink. It is made of materials that are safe for health and food-neutral. Not suitable for hot drinks.

records.Name: Food dryer
records.Description: Very practical food dryer with a power of 550 W. Suitable for drying mushrooms, vegetables, fruits and herbs. Due to the dehydration process, these products are easy to preserve. The food dryer works really quietly and its noise does not disturb everyday life. Large pallets allow you to put a lot of details on them. At the same time, due to the fact that the pallets can be placed on top of each other, the device takes up little space. Due to the 2 levels of temperature control, the dehydration process can be performed with varying intensities. For safety reasons, the dehumidifier is equipped with an overheating protection system that automatically shuts off the appliance if necessary.

records.Name: Meat Tenderiser Fackelmann 32 cm.
records.Description: Meat tenderizer made of beech wood and aluminium. 32 cm long, this meat tenderizer is perfect for tenderizing and nerving your piece of meat. Made of very good quality beech wood, the tenderizer is easy to handle and comfortable to handle.

records.Name: High pot with stainless steel lid
records.Description:
Professional high pot with lid, measuring 36x36 cm and capacity 36.6 l.
This pot is designed for professional use in the catering industry. It is perfect for preparing all kinds of dishes.
It is made of high quality 21/0 stainless steel, specially developed for use in gastronomy. The most important advantage of pots made of this type of steel is the heat conduction by up to 30% higher compared to standard pots made of 304 steel. They are also characterized by increased resistance to mechanical damage and the action of organic acids and detergents. That is why they are dishwasher-safe and resistant to intensive scrubbing of surfaces.
Importantly, pots made of 21/0 steel do not contain manganese and nickel harmful to human health.
The special design of the capsule bottom distributes heat evenly over the entire surface of the bottom, which increases the degree of heat utilization and cooking efficiency. This translates directly into their quality and comfort of the cook's work. This solution also reduces the risk of food burning.

records.Name: Radiator 450mm x 400mm
records.Description: With a slim profile and smooth, white finish, radiator will blend into any room in the house, to provide guaranteed heating performance. Strictly controlled independent laboratory testing ensures that the radiators are guaranteed to perform to a maximum working pressure of 145 psi (10 bar), and conform to BS EN 442, the European Standard for radiators.

records.Name: Chest of drawers
records.Description:
This chest of drawers, featuring a minimalist design, will make a practical as well as highly decorative addition to your home. With 3 drawers, the sideboard provides ample storage space for books, multimedia appliances and other items. The sturdy tabletop is ideal for displaying decorative objects, photo frames, or potted plants. It can also be used as a low board, side cabinet, etc. Thanks to the premium engineered wood material, this sideboard is built to last. The drawer cabinet is easy to clean with a damp cloth.
Color: White and sonoma oak
Dimensions: 70 x 40 x 76 cm (W x D x H)
Material: Chipboard

records.Name: Bedside table
records.Description:
Bring a classic charm to your interior with our bedside table! Made of high quality cardboard, this bedside table is sturdy, durable and versatile. As a universal chest, you can also use it as a coffee table in the living room. 2 drawers provide ample storage space to keep your magazines, books, remote controls and other small items well organized and within easy reach. In addition, this bedside table is easy to clean with a damp cloth. Brighten up your interior with our elegant bedside table! Easy to assemble with included mounting material.
Colour: white and Sonoma oak.
Material: Particle board 
Dimensions: 40 x 30 x 40 cm (W x D x H).

records.Name: AKORD Lima Kitchen Furniture Set
records.Description:
The Lima kitchen furniture set from Akord offers space for everything you need for preparing meals - crockery, cutlery, food. This furniture set includes both wall cabinets and standing cabinets. Here you will also find practical drawers. It is perfect for a small room. It is spacious and does not visually crush the arrangement.

records.Name: Bathroom cabinet
records.Description:
With this washing machine cabinet, you can create and optimally use additional storage space in the bathroom. The clean lines and sleek design make it blend into your bathroom perfectly.
Made of chipboard, the bathroom cupboard is sturdy and durable. This cabinet is easy to clean with damp cloth. This washing machine cupboard is easy to assemble with included mounting materials.
The 2 open compartments and 2 doors offer ample storage room for keeping your laundry utensils, cleaning supplies, toiletries and other items well organized and within reach.

With 2 doors and 2 open compartments.

records.Name: Laser distance meter
records.Description:
This Laser Distance Meter adopts laser technology to measure distance, area and volume accurately, quickly and conveniently. It has a wide measuring range 120m and high accuracy of ±2mm. In addition, this meter can make use of Pythagorean Theorem to measure distances or lengths indirectly when direct measurement is not feasible.
This laser distance meter also has various functions including continuous measurement, addition/subtraction function and Max/Min measurements. Other main features are including 100 units memories, switchable units (metre, inch & feet) & backlight LCD with multi-line display. The bubbles level equipped can be used as a spirit level tool.

records.Name: Blanket 220x200
records.Description: The fabric we utilize for the blanket is 100% microfiber polyester which has double-faced plush with graceful luster. The fluffy blanket allows you to enjoy the coziness on both sides of this blanket and improves your sleep. The thickness of the throw blanket is just right, you can use it as bed sheet, couch blanket, baby stroller blanket, nap sleep blanket. Great for outdoor use such as camping, travelling, study room. And you can wrap youself in the flannel fleece blanket on sofa for watching TV series, reading, having a comfy nap in the office with our cozzy blanket.
